geoparquet-items.title: All items as stac-geoparquet
geoparquet-items.description: A stac-geoparquet copy of the 24986 items of this collection, one row for each item, in Hilbert order of the item bbox.

overview.title: Land cover 2022, whole world (COG)
overview.description: All 961 tiles of 2022 in one 8-bit RGBA image in Web Mercator (EPSG:3857) at about 2.4 km, in the class colors. Made from the tiles' internal overviews with mode resampling, so it is for display only.

thumbnail.title: Land cover 2022 preview
thumbnail.description: The 2022 overview from 60°S to about 84°N, 900 by 600 pixels, with no basemap.
